topic: Training as practice for character: the patience that keeps us on the last rep, a slow pace or an honest meal is the same patience we carry into work and the rest of the day; training the body also trains the mind
figure: Musonius Rufus, Roman Stoic teacher of the 1st century AD and teacher of Epictetus (Lectures 6, On Training: there is training for the soul alone and training common to soul and body; by accustoming ourselves to cold, heat, hunger, thirst, simple food and enduring hardship, the body is strengthened and the soul is trained for courage and self-control). Paraphrased, not quoted. Single quote page, at Mintra's request
